hints.title: Compute Total Invoice Spending
hints.text: Join purchases with products on product id to calculate the sum of quantity * price for each invoice.

hints.title: Identify Top Invoice
hints.text: Order invoices by total spending descending and invoice id ascending to break ties, limiting to the first invoice.

hints.title: Retrieve Invoice Line Items
hints.text: Join the selected invoice back to purchases and products to output product id, quantity, and total item price.

hints.title: Common Table Expression Query Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
with invoice_totals as (
    select
        p.invoice_id,
        sum(p.quantity * pr.price) as total_price
    from Purchases p
    join Products pr on p.product_id = pr.product_id
    group by p.invoice_id
    order by total_price desc, p.invoice_id asc
    limit 1
)
select
    p.product_id,
    p.quantity,
    p.quantity * pr.price as price
from Purchases p
join Products pr on p.product_id = pr.product_id
where p.invoice_id = (select invoice_id from invoice_totals);
```

complexity.notes: Hash join and group aggregation followed by single top-invoice filter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subquery per line item checking max invoice price causes quadratic overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: CTE isolates top invoice id before item retrieval.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Employs common table expression or subquery to select top invoice by spending and id tie-breaker.
